[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
Isabel Glasgow was born on 12 May 1755 and baptised on 16 May 1755 in Leith, according to an indexed parish-register transcript. It names her father as John Glasgow, a workman, and her mother as Christian “Mook”; Leith North is given as their residence.<ref name="FMP-4501260">[https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=SCOT%2FOPR%2FBAP%2F4501260&tab=this Findmypast, Scotland, Parish Births & Baptisms 1564–1929, Isabel Glasgow, OPR 692/3, item 2, page 76; birth 12 May and baptism 16 May 1755; provider transcript inspected, original register image uninspected.]</ref> These names and dates strongly fit the existing daughter of [[Glasgow-3481|John Glasgow]] and [[Meek-3817|Christian Meek]], while the transcript’s “Mook” surname requires comparison with the held “Meek” account.
